about: KS3 topics. Each topic is a folder: ks3/Year 8/01 Topic name/. Upload files into it and they appear on ks3.html a minute or two later. Name files like '1 - LESSON - Under the Hood.pptx' or '3 - WORKSHEET - Binary.docx': the number sets the order and the word sets the type (LESSON, NOTES, WORKSHEET, HOMEWORK, ACTIVITY, PRACTICAL, ASSIGNMENT, HELPSHEET). Here you can give a topic a nicer title, a short summary, what pupils learn, and mark it temporary. A folder not listed here still shows, titled from its folder name.
